bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Filed by the bank as 'Financial Statements for the Period ended 30 June 2018' (a discrete '2nd Quarter'/half-yearly filing, not separately labelled 'Half Yearly' in this instance). Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2017. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2018 (H1 YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Apr-Jun 2018) figures, not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; extracted via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3). Cross-checks: 31-Dec-2017 comparative matches 2017_Q4.json; income-statement chain closes exactly once provision D is correctly derived as C minus PBT (D=-15,394,721, a net recovery -- the source's 'Specific provision (Written back)' label and inconsistent OCR parenthesization made the raw printed sign ambiguous, but the derived value is corroborated by decomposing it into Q1-2018's already-established -16,702,875 recovery (see 2018_Q1.json) plus a small +1,308,154 charge in Q2-2018 alone). RESTATEMENT FOUND (not reconciled, per project convention): this filing's own Statement of Changes in Equity shows a 'Prior year adjustment' of approximately -13,396,230 taka applied to the 1-January-2018 opening retained earnings/equity (moving it from the previously-reported -17,731,371,664 / -10,451,586,781 to a restated -17,744,733,700ish / -10,464,948,817ish, exact trailing digits noisy under OCR) -- this restated opening balance is NOT reflected in the comparative column shown on the face of this filing's own Balance Sheet (which still shows the original, unrestated -17,731,371,664 / -10,451,586,781, matching 2017_Q4.json), so the Balance Sheet comparative and the Statement of Changes in Equity are internally inconsistent by this ~13.4m-taka adjustment within the bank's own filing. 2017_Q4.json is left unmodified (contemporaneous figure preferred).
